title: 第十三章 奇人怪事谁是傻子第十四章 柳陌花巷凶案再现
content_zh:
二人一前一后走出县衙，此时天际已经换了颜色。
黑夜中的繁星点点，犹如镶嵌在锦袍之上的夜明珠，令人沉醉、着迷。
县衙位于运城北方，离西南方的怡红院相差甚远，几乎隔了半座城池。
铁棠也不着急，缓缓在大街上行走，一边细细品味自己如今修为，一边查看运城的风土人情。
运城不设宵禁！
加上治安良好，捕快众多，一旦有什么冲突都能快速响应，是以商业也算发达。
即便是黑幕遮天，街道两边的小贩、商铺、酒楼、茶肆也没有打烊，反倒一个个在门头挂起大红灯笼，吸引过往路人。
行约半程。
一间老旧茶肆吸引了铁棠目光。
门前一株苍翠柳树，青瓦遮头，红砖铺地，围了一圈的方桌藤椅坐得满满当当，都是喝茶闲谈之人。
三月正值春末，气候最是凉爽。
一撮茶叶，一壶热水，一把边果，不慌不忙地在茶肆坐上一晚，与街坊谈天地，与知交论古今，任凭春风拂面。
这又是何等的逍遥自在？
袁骅一个没留神，差点撞到铁棠身上，他还在想自己身前这位爷.....是啥时候突破到易筋的？
“头？要不咱也过去坐坐？”
铁棠摇了摇头，看向柳树下方，那里正蹲着一位埋头沉思的少年郎。
他体型瘦小，披头散发，身上青灰素袍脏兮兮的，简直像个乞丐。
但茶肆周围闲谈的人群却纷纷避开了那里，无人敢上前。
只因在他腰间，有一把狭长的刀器横挂，犹如腰悬弯月，又似雁翎浮沉。
秋水雁翎刀！

顺着铁棠的目光，袁骅也认出了此人，不禁骂骂咧咧地走了过去。
“你小子怎么躲这偷懒？好几日不见你公值，我还以为你不干了。”
少年斜着脑袋瞟了一眼袁骅，重新将头埋了回去。
“小爷去哪还得跟你汇报不成？你别靠我太近，身上那股味我受不了。”
袁骅抬起右臂闻了闻，又换左手嗅了嗅，没感觉有什么异味，好奇问道：“我身上什么味？”
少年头也不抬，笑呵呵道：“马屁味。”
“比岐！你......”
“哈哈！”
铁棠乐了，大笑出声，这小子还是这么损。
少年人怪，名字也怪，不过当他听到铁棠的笑声，马上就从地上站了起来。
“棠哥儿，你怎得来了？”
content_en:
The two walked out of the county government office one after another. At this time, the sky had changed color.
The stars in the dark night are like night pearls inlaid on brocade robes, which is intoxicating and fascinating.
The county government office is located in the north of Yuncheng, far away from Yihongyuan in the southwest, almost half a city away.
Tie Tang was not in a hurry and walked slowly on the street, savoring his current cultivation while checking out the customs and customs of Yuncheng.
There is no curfew in Yuncheng!
In addition, the public security is good, there are many police officers, and they can respond quickly if there is any conflict, so the business is also developed.
Even though it was dark, the vendors, shops, restaurants, and teahouses on both sides of the street did not close. Instead, they hung red lanterns above their doors to attract passers-by.
About half way.
An old tea shop caught Tie Tang's attention.
There is a green willow tree in front of the door, with green tiles covering its head, red bricks paving the floor, and square tables and wicker chairs in a circle filled with people drinking tea and chatting.
March is the end of spring, and the climate is the coolest.
With a pinch of tea leaves, a pot of hot water, and a handful of berries, I sat leisurely in a tea shop for a night, chatting with my neighbors about the world, discussing the past and present with my close friends, and letting the spring breeze blow on my face.
How carefree is this?
Yuan Hua was not paying attention and almost bumped into Tie Tang. He was still thinking about the man in front of him... When did he break through to Yi Jin?
"Boss? How about we come over and sit down too?"
Tie Tang shook his head and looked under the willow tree, where a young man squatted deep in thought.
He was thin, with disheveled hair, and his dirty gray plain robe made him look like a beggar.
But the chattering crowd around the tea shop avoided it, and no one dared to come forward.
Just because there was a long and narrow knife hanging horizontally on his waist, like a crescent moon hanging from his waist, and like a wild goose feather floating and sinking.
Qiu Shui Yan Fei Dao!
Following Tie Tang's gaze, Yuan Hua also recognized this person and walked over cursing.
"Why are you hiding here and being lazy? I haven't seen you on duty for several days, so I thought you quit."
The young man tilted his head and glanced at Yuan Hua, then buried his head again.
"Do I have to report to you where I'm going? Don't get too close to me. I can't stand the smell on you."
Yuan Hua raised his right arm and smelled it, then switched to his left hand and smelled it. He didn't feel any peculiar smell, so he asked curiously: "What does it smell like on me?"
The young man didn't even raise his head and said with a smile: "It tastes like flattery."
"Biqi! You..."
"Haha!"
Tie Tang was amused and laughed loudly, this kid was still so bad.
The young man had a strange personality and a strange name, but when he heard Tie Tang's laughter, he immediately stood up from the ground.
"Brother Tang, why are you here?"
